des: Copy this file to data/.mcp_server_settings.json to enable explicitly reviewed MCP services.
Only independently operated loopback HTTP/SSE services are supported by the current service policy.
Subprocess/package-installing transports are unavailable. Start your tool service separately.
Example entry: {"url":"http://127.0.0.1:8001/mcp","transport":"streamable-http"}. No tools are enabled by default.
